close_reason: Decided per Mark 2026-05-13: refined Option A — switch to Strict generation .3 (not Multipurpose .2). Implementation tracked in PKIX-jbvb.7. Multi-generation surface deferred to PKIX-jbvb.8.
description:
## The discrepancy

PKIX-jbvb.{2,3} shipped with DN rules that ENFORCE attributes the CA/B Forum S/MIME BR Legacy generation tier marks as MAY (optional). The bead descriptions conflated the BR's Multipurpose/Strict generation requirements with the Legacy generation policy OID (`2.23.140.1.5.X.1` suffix is Legacy).

Per BR §7.1.4.2.5 (Sponsor-validated) Legacy column:
- organizationName: SHALL
- organizationIdentifier: SHALL  ← also required, was missed by all 3 beads
- givenName / surname / pseudonym: MAY  ← but PKIX-jbvb.2 requires (givenName+surname OR pseudonym)
- serialNumber: MAY  ← but PKIX-jbvb.2 requires it
- Note 1: 'Legacy Generation profiles MAY omit the subject:givenName, subject:surname, and subject:pseudonym attributes and include only the subject:commonName'

Per BR §7.1.4.2.6 (Individual-validated) Legacy column:
- organizationName: SHALL NOT
- All other tier-distinguishing attrs (givenName/surname/pseudonym/serialNumber): MAY
- Note 1: same Legacy permissive note

Per BR §7.1.4.2.4 (Organization-validated) Legacy column:
- organizationName: SHALL
- organizationIdentifier: SHALL
- givenName/surname/pseudonym: SHALL NOT
- serialNumber: MAY

## Why this matters

The shipped Profile types REJECT certs that the BR Legacy tier allows. For a Profile claiming 'CA/B Forum S/MIME BR Legacy generation conformance', that's a false negative — rejecting valid certs.

## Options

**Option A: Switch Profile types to Multipurpose generation (policy OID suffix `.2`).**
- DN rules I shipped align with §7.1.4.2.5 / .6 Multipurpose column Note 2: 'SHALL include either subject:givenName and/or subject:surname, or the subject:pseudonym'
- Requires also adding `organizationIdentifier` for Org-validated and Sponsor-validated tiers (SHALL in all three columns)
- Smallest correction to the shipped code (change policy OID suffix, add OrgIdentifier for Org/Sponsor)
- Multipurpose generation has a different max_validity_secs (per §6.3.2: ?days, need to look up)

**Option B: Loosen DN rules to match Legacy generation.**
- DN rules become very permissive (basically nothing required beyond what Mailbox-validated requires)
- Tier discrimination collapses to just the policy OID
- Less useful as a marquee reference (the whole point of a tier-specific Profile is to capture the tier's distinguishing predicates)
- Need to ADD organizationIdentifier as SHALL for Org and Sponsor

**Option C: Ship Legacy + Multipurpose + Strict variants per tier (9 new types instead of 3).**
- Most spec-accurate
- Doubles/triples the Profile surface
- Likely overkill for a marquee reference

## Cascading correction work (regardless of option)

1. **Add organizationIdentifier (OID 2.5.4.97) to OID constants.** Required by BR Org and Sponsor tiers across ALL generations.
2. **PKIX-jbvb.2 (Sponsor) shipped without organizationIdentifier requirement.** Needs amendment.
3. **PKIX-jbvb.3 (Individual) shipped with serialNumber as SHALL.** BR Legacy makes it MAY; Multipurpose/Strict make it MAY too actually. So this rule is over-strict in ALL cases. The bead author may have meant 'serialNumber as a discriminator from CN-only certs' but BR doesn't require it.

## Recommendation

**Option A** with a follow-on bead documenting that the per-tier Profile types target Multipurpose generation (OID suffix `.2`), not Legacy (`.1`). This:
- Validates the DN rules I shipped (with the OrgIdentifier addition)
- Keeps the tier discrimination meaningful
- Matches the marquee-reference value of -cabf crates

If Option A is chosen, PKIX-jbvb.1 (Organization) ships with the new OID suffix and DN rule `AllOf([organizationName, organizationIdentifier])` (consistent with Org Multipurpose). PKIX-jbvb.2 and .3 amendments file as new beads.

If Option B is chosen, all three Profile types' DN rules need to loosen.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jbvb (parent)
- PKIX-jbvb.1 (blocked until this decision)
- PKIX-jbvb.2 (shipped, may need correction)
- PKIX-jbvb.3 (shipped, may need correction)
- PKIX-jbvb.4 (ValidationPolicy fields — unaffected, the new fields are correct for any option)
- PKIX-jbvb.5 (fixture sourcing — unaffected)
- BR §7.1.4.2.4/.5/.6 in `specs/cabforum-smime-BR.md`

## Blocks

This bead blocks PKIX-jbvb.1 (Organization-validated cannot ship until DN-rule strictness is decided).
title: Decide: S/MIME tier Profile DN rules: Legacy generation vs Multipurpose/Strict
